description: WRITE: create a learner account. Deliberately no password or admin flag — set send_registration_email so the learner sets their own password. LearnWorlds: POST /v2/users.

fields.description: Sign-up fields to set, e.g. {"company": "Acme", "phone": "+1..."}. Built-in keys include bio, location, url, phone, address, country, birthday, company, company_size, university, graduation_year and social links; custom fields use their cf_ key (e.g. cf_skill).

send_registration_email.description: Send LearnWorlds' registration email to the user.

signup_validation_rules.description: Apply the school's sign-up validation rules (default false).

tags.description: Tags to attach to the new user.

name: learnworlds_create_user
title: Create a user
